name: Media Playback State Sync
description: Fix Spotify play/pause state inconsistency by cross-validating NowPlayingCLI data with MediaRemote direct API and adding notification-driven delayed re-queries. Only modifies MediaService.swift.

userStories.title: Add validation state properties
userStories.description: As a developer, I need validation state tracking properties so that the new validation flow can manage concurrent queries and follow-up requests.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `private var needsFollowupValidation = false` after existing `needsFollowupUpdate` property in MediaService
Add `private var validationTask: Task<Void, Never>?` after needsFollowupValidation
xcodebuild -scheme NemoNotch -configuration Debug build succeeds
userStories.notes: File: NemoNotch/Services/MediaService.swift. These are two simple private properties, no logic yet.

userStories.title: Add mergePlaybackState helper
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a merge function that cross-validates NowPlayingCLI data with MediaRemote direct API, preferring MediaRemote for playbackRate when they disagree.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `private func mergePlaybackState(cliInfo: [String: Any]?, mrInfo: [String: Any]?) -> [String: Any]?` method to MediaService
Method returns mrInfo when cliInfo is nil, cliInfo when mrInfo is nil
When both exist and disagree on isPlaying (playbackRate > 0), overrides cliInfo's playbackRate with mrInfo's value
Method is placed before applyInfo() in the file
xcodebuild -scheme NemoNotch -configuration Debug build succeeds
userStories.notes: File: NemoNotch/Services/MediaService.swift. Pure function, no side effects. Insert before the existing applyInfo method.

userStories.title: Add updateNowPlayingWithValidation method
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a new query path that fires both NowPlayingCLI and MediaRemote.getNowPlayingInfo, merges results, then schedules a 250ms confirmatory re-query.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `private func updateNowPlayingWithValidation()` to MediaService, placed after existing updateNowPlaying() method
Method checks isUpdatingNowPlaying guard and sets needsFollowupValidation if busy
Fires nowPlayingCLI.fetchNowPlayingInfo, then inside its callback fires remote.getNowPlayingInfo
Calls mergePlaybackState with both results then applyInfo with merged result
After applying, calls scheduleValidationFollowup() to queue a 250ms re-query
Add `private func scheduleValidationFollowup()` that cancels previous validationTask and schedules updateNowPlaying() after 250ms delay
xcodebuild -scheme NemoNotch -configuration Debug build succeeds
userStories.notes: File: NemoNotch/Services/MediaService.swift. The MediaRemote.getNowPlayingInfo callback is nested inside the CLI callback so both results are available before merge. getNowPlayingInfo dispatches to main queue so this is safe.

userStories.title: Classify notifications into state vs metadata paths
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to split notification handlers so state-change notifications use the validation path and metadata notifications use the existing simple poll path.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace entire setupNotifications() method in MediaService
State notifications (kMRMediaRemoteNowPlayingApplicationIsPlayingDidChangeNotification, com.spotify.client.PlaybackStateChanged) call updateNowPlayingWithValidation()
Metadata notifications (kMRMediaRemoteNowPlayingInfoDidChangeNotification, kMRMediaRemoteNowPlayingApplicationDidChangeNotification, com.apple.Music.playerInfo) call updateNowPlaying()
All 5 notifications from the original code are still registered
xcodebuild -scheme NemoNotch -configuration Debug build succeeds
userStories.notes: File: NemoNotch/Services/MediaService.swift. Replace the existing setupNotifications() method. The notification names must match exactly — copy them from the existing code.

userStories.title: Add validationTask cleanup to deinit
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to cancel the validation task when MediaService is deallocated to prevent dangling tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `validationTask?.cancel()` to the existing deinit block in MediaService
xcodebuild -scheme NemoNotch -configuration Debug build succeeds
userStories.notes: File: NemoNotch/Services/MediaService.swift. One line addition to existing deinit block, after reconcileTask?.cancel().
